It sells Tykables-branded products using the brand owner's product photos and product descriptions copied word for word, without permission, at a fake 65% discount (for example $9.26 marked down to $3.24). Other pages are generic fashion-store template text (testimonials about a "blazer," a "contemporary fashion destination" About page) that do not match the products sold. The domain was registered on 2026-09-18 with a privacy-redacted registrant and is hosted on a server registered in China. The checkout uses Stripe. This looks like a fake store set up to take payments for goods that will not ship. Buyers should avoid it. The real brands' official sites are tykables.com and nru.co.uk.
